She is known for her unwavering faith and dedication to Islam, even amidst the polytheistic Arabian society. Houda was a member of the Quraish tribe and was married to Abdullah ibn Abdul-Muttalib, who was the paternal uncle of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
